title: An Approximate Version of Vu's Theorem on Economical Subbases For Non-Integer Exponents
summary: We prove an approximate analog of Vu's Theorem on economical bases of $k$th powers for non-integer powers. Fix a non-integer $θ> 2$ and real $τ> 0$. Let $s \geq θ^2+9θ^{3/2}+2 $ if $θ> 3$ and $s \geq (\lfloor 2θ\rfloor+1)(\lfloor 2θ\rfloor+2)+1$ if $2 0$.
